column6: Repository and (if any) runtime access granted by the owner; source workbook available
column7: A written inventory of what actually exists (code, deployment, integrations, secrets, data) with evidence; the five source contradictions logged; owner has ratified the authoritative version and the reconciled execution sequence

column6: Inventory complete; target platform and datastore decided and recorded as an ADR
column7: Cross-tenant negative tests pass (AT-SEC-001); role matrix enforced with negative tests per role; append-only audit store proven tamper-evident; core schema migrated with constraints

column6: Identity, tenancy and audit operational from PHASE-01
column7: AT-FILE-001 passes (EICAR and zip bomb quarantined with no parsing and no model call); artifact versioning with SHA-256 and object lock proven; digest mutation detected

AT-WF-001 and AT-WF-002 pass; worker restart loses no job; repeated idempotency key produces no duplicate side effect; outbox delivers with dedupe; template registry rejects retired versions and invalid schemas

column3: AI gateway, model registry, routing and budget
column6: Workflow runtime can dispatch typed tasks; secrets vault available
column7: Policy engine logs 100 percent of decisions and fails closed; two independent providers exercised; chaos 429/5xx/timeout produces a bounded, tested fallback; budget cap stops a runaway loop; usage ledger posts exactly once and reconciles
Unregistered tool is blocked at dispatch; malformed result envelope fails closed; immutable agent versions with canary and proven rollback; context package isolation test passes

column6: Rights register exists and the legal owner is assigned
column7: AT-RAG-001 passes (a source with UNKNOWN rights yields no excerpt and no embedding); every citation carries source, version, anchor and rights snapshot; per-collection isolation proven

column6: Typed artifact and evidence chain available; reviewer registry data source agreed
column7: AT-REV-001, AT-REV-002 and AT-DEL-001 pass; self-review is rejected; hard filters are non-overridable; no release occurs before a signed review bound to the reviewed digest

column6: Owner has supplied an executed rate card, or the environment is explicitly marked non-commercial
column7: AT-PRICE-001, AT-PAY-001 and AT-PAY-002 pass; a success redirect without a verified webhook activates nothing; duplicate and out-of-order provider events are idempotent; no PAN or CVV is stored anywhere

column3: Villa golden path end to end
column6: All upstream phases at their exit condition
column7: The ten-stage WF-VILLA-REVIEW path runs end to end on a real drawing set with a complete audit trail, satisfying evidence-ledger gate G01
Nine dashboards live with tested alerts; a single trace links task to agent, model, tool, evidence and review; DR restore drill meets a stated RTO and RPO; usage reconciles against provider billing

column6: Audit store and data inventory complete
column7: AT-PRIV-001 passes across access, correction and destruction; verified deletion proven; red-team suite covers prompt injection, tool exfiltration and egress; residency assessed per provider; breach tabletop completed

column6: Evidence pipeline and consent model operational
column7: Device matrix tested; consent, redaction and deletion proven; live analysis samples frames within a measured latency and cost budget; LiDAR output carries confidence and an explicit non-survey disclaimer with mandatory human validation

column3: Admin control plane, connectors and support operations
column6: Platform API and policy service available
column7: No direct browser-to-agent or browser-to-database path exists; admin RBAC matrix enforced with negative tests; dual control on production secrets and policies; connector register, probe, rotate and revoke proven; break-glass expires automatically

column6: At least one vertical runs end to end and telemetry is trustworthy
column7: All thirteen acceptance tests executed with attached evidence; regression gate blocks a sub-threshold candidate; evidence ledger populated from reproducible runs; no artifact claims READY without build reference, passed test, evidence link and approver

column6: Villa path green and the evaluation harness trusted
column7: Each added workflow has a defined and executed test suite, validated tools, an eligible reviewer pool and its own pricing model before exposure
